narrator_tr.text: Ben hep buradaydım, çekmecede, mektupların altında. Sofrayı, penceredeki ışığı ve sana dönen her yüzü hatırlıyorum. Otur. Sana nasıl bittiğini anlatacağım.
narrator_tr.designed_from: A mature woman in her fifties, low warm alto voice, calm, unhurried, intimate, soft-spoken, close to the microphone, telling a bedtime story

narrator_en.text: I have been here all along, in the drawer, under the letters. I remember the table, the light in the window, and every face that turned to look at you. Sit down. I will tell you how it ends.
